trials.citation: Egan MF et al., N Engl J Med 2018;378:1691-1703, DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa1706441, PMC6776074

apoe4.basis: reported: 63.6% carriers (415 of 653); Genotype split of the carriers is not reported in this paper: the 24.8% homozygous share of carriers that bapineuzumab 301 reports (Salloway 2014 Table 1: 325 heterozygous, 107 homozygous of 432) is used, an assumption.

trials.backgroundBasis: AChEI, memantine or both 89.3% (583/653), a stable dose for 3 months before screening

completion.basis: 70.2 to 72.1% of all arms completed part 1

A longitudinal ANCOVA is read as the MMRM family.
